full_name: Allison Daminger | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2021–2022 Social Sciences Edna Newman Shapiro, Class of 1936, and Robert Newman Shapiro, Class of 1972, Graduate Student Fellow Harvard University
bio: Allison Daminger is a PhD candidate in sociology & social policy at Harvard University. She uses qualitative research methods to study the relationship between gender inequality and family life.
